answer: A sponsor stakes a 60-credit bond for each new agent. Reputation starts at 100, falling 5 per epoch without attestations. Each honest attestation is a pearl on record. The reputation summit takes 20 honest epochs to reach. Attestations bear a cipher seal only the sponsor can open. At zero the bond is slashed and both are ejected. 1,000 fake identities cost 60,000 credits; decay drains idle fakes. An honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted.
